description: This file manages license-related functionalities within the Mattermost server, including license retrieval, validation, saving, and license request handling with support for trial licenses and JWT claims.

classes.name: JWTClaims
classes.description: Custom JWT claims structure containing license ID and active users count for renewal process.

methods.name: License
methods.description: Retrieves the current license from the server or channel context.

methods.name: RequestTrialLicenseWithExtraFields
methods.description: Handles the request for a trial license with additional client-provided fields, including validation and sanitization.

methods.name: RequestTrialLicense
methods.description: Deprecated method for requesting a trial license with basic parameters, now superseded by RequestTrialLicenseWithExtraFields.

methods.name: LoadLicense
methods.description: Loads the license data into the platform.

methods.name: SaveLicense
methods.description: Saves the license data and returns the license object.

methods.name: SetLicense
methods.description: Sets a new license for the platform.

methods.name: ValidateAndSetLicenseBytes
methods.description: Validates and sets license data from byte array.

methods.name: ClientLicense
methods.description: Retrieves the current client license information.

methods.name: RemoveLicense
methods.description: Removes the current license from the platform.

methods.name: AddLicenseListener
methods.description: Adds a listener for license changes.

methods.name: RemoveLicenseListener
methods.description: Removes a license change listener by ID.

methods.name: GetSanitizedClientLicense
methods.description: Retrieves a sanitized version of the client license data.
